name: Follow That Kobold!
label: Quest
description: Follow That Kobold!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.
Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
